claims.evidence: Origin of use cannot be determined from visual inspection of the hardware.
The witness did not see the console powered on or the digital library.
The witness observed the console and controllers without reporting physical damage or heavy wear.
The witness did not report on the status of the warranty seals on the rear of the console.
Thermal performance requires extended testing under load.
The witness did not see the ports tested or even the rear connection ports.
The witness confirmed two wireless controllers are present, though their specific 'originality' to this bundle is unverified.
The witness did not see any documentation or receipts.

risks.risk: Optical disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.
risks.proof: A video clip showing a disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and then ejected.
risks.if_unproven: As a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: Internal storage (HDD) may be the minimum 500GB or failing.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in settings.
risks.if_unproven: As a 500GB model with a drive needing replacement.

risks.risk: Controllers may have 'stick drift' or poor battery life.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers navigating menus without ghost inputs.

proof_requests: Video of the console booting up to the main menu.
Photo of the 'System Storage' settings page.
Photo of the rear of the console showing the warranty seals.
Video of a game disc being loaded and played.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned by the seller.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a PlayStation 4 Limited Edition. It can be priced at its worst-case functional value, assuming no games and standard storage.
